en: Prākṛtī — another name for the Tripurā

occurrences.snippet: Three kinds of bānsurī are chiefly recognised: the Jihvāvatī and the Kṛṣṇā, and the third is the Prākṛtī.
The Prākṛtī bānsurī, which is held to be the Tripurā, has a peculiar way of blowing; it is simple to make, but it causes faults of mudrā (posture).
